title: Replay reveal: what happened next
hook: The mystery stock was Google, in September 2007.
takeaway: The Replay stock was Google on September 21, 2007. Bought at that close, it never closed below the buy price and was up 32% six weeks later. Then the market topped. A simple sell rule (exit on a close below the 50-day average) sold in December with +20%; holding and hoping was −25% by March 2008. Plan the sell before you buy.
learn: The Replay stock was Google: bought at the September 21, 2007 close, it was up 32% six weeks later.
When the market topped, it gave the gains back; a close below the 50-day average (the average close of the last 50 days) sold it in December, up 20%.
Holding and hoping turned the same trade into a 25% loss by March 2008: plan the sell before you buy.
emotion: the relief of being right, then the slow sinking feeling of watching it leak away
